articles.title: 苹果Siri部分高级AI功能将收费
articles.summary: 苹果CEO透露Siri每天处理超25亿次请求，部分高级AI功能未来会向用户收费。
articles.why: Siri是很多人每天用的工具，收费意味着免费AI助手的好日子可能慢慢收紧。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 值得观察：哪些AI功能会先开始收费？
articles.source_title: 苹果 CEO 特努斯：Siri 每日处理超过 25 亿次请求，部分高级 AI 功能将收费

articles.title: 纽约时报起诉Brave浏览器
articles.summary: 纽约时报等多家媒体起诉Brave浏览器，指控其用AI抓取内容训练模型并帮用户绕过付费墙。
articles.why: 这关系到以后网上内容还能不能免费看到，也影响AI公司获取训练数据的方式。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 可以想：AI抓取内容和版权之间该怎么平衡？
articles.source_title: The New York Times sues Brave web browser for AI scraping and bypassing paywalls

articles.title: Trajectory融资让非技术者训练AI
articles.summary: 成立一年的Trajectory获4500万美元融资，估值3亿美元，目标是让不懂技术的人也能训练AI模型。
articles.why: 如果真能做到，未来不用写代码也能定制自己的AI，对文科背景的人是个好消息。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注：不用编程就能训练AI，离普通人还有多远？
articles.source_title: Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts

articles.title: 高通AI Hub向中国开发者开放
articles.summary: 高通宣布AI Hub面向中国开发者开放，提供230多个预优化模型和端侧AI开发工具。
articles.why: 这意味着更多手机上的AI功能可能更快出现，开发者做AI应用的门槛也降低了。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 可以留意：手机本地跑AI会带来哪些新玩法？
articles.source_title: 高通：高通 AI Hub 现已面向中国开发者开放

articles.title: Anthropic限制Claude克隆游戏
articles.summary: Anthropic更新Claude Code规则，禁止用它复刻现有电子游戏，但仍允许制作原创游戏。
articles.why: 说明AI公司开始给AI工具划边界，用AI做东西时要注意别踩版权红线。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 用AI创作时，原创和抄袭的界线值得留意。
articles.source_title: Anthropic clamps down on Claude’s AI video game clones

articles.title: OpenAI推电网保护计划
articles.summary: OpenAI宣布在佐治亚州数据中心试点电网保护计划，紧急时可释放最多1000兆瓦电力给周边。
articles.why: AI数据中心耗电巨大引发不满，这类补救措施会影响未来AI基建能不能顺利建下去。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注：AI用电问题会不会影响你所在地区的电价？
articles.source_title: OpenAI pitches data center power plants as a way to protect nearby areas

articles.title: Y Combinator合伙人年花20万美元用AI
articles.summary: YC合伙人Garry Tan称自己大量使用AI代理，一年花在token上的钱高达20万美元。
articles.why: 说明重度用户已经在AI上花大钱，普通用户需要想想自己愿意为AI工具付多少。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 可以算算：你每月愿意为AI工具花多少钱？
articles.source_title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens

items.title_en: DecisionRank: On-Policy Distillation for Decision-Model Rerankers
items.summary: Decision models target structured tasks by directly predicting choices or scores, avoiding autoregressive decoding latency. However, transferring a generative LLM's ranking knowledge to a decision model remains challenging: the teacher expresses preferences through a ranked list of document ID sequences, while the student determines the ranking using scores from the first-token position. To bridge this gap, we introduce DecisionRank, a decision model trained through item-space on-policy distilla
items.title_cn: DecisionRank：面向决策模型重排序器的同策略蒸馏
items.note: 把生成式大模型的排序知识蒸馏给决策模型，解决两者打分方式不一致的问题。

items.title_en: Diagnosing the Reference Gap: What Visual Scaffolds Can and Cannot Fix in Multimodal Reasoning
items.summary: Multimodal large language models can recognize visual content yet struggle to reason reliably over it across multiple steps. In counting, a model may see all objects but lose track of which ones it has counted. We argue that such failures, commonly attributed to perception, reveal a reference gap: the failure to bind language to the relevant visual entities, regions, or locations. Motivated by the theory of visual routines, we test whether external references such as numbering can narrow this ga
items.title_cn: 诊断引用鸿沟：视觉支架在多模态推理中能修什么、不能修什么
items.note: 指出多模态模型多步推理失败源于语言与视觉实体绑定失败，测试编号等外部引用能否弥补。

items.title_en: DeFT-RAG: Decomposing Multi-Hop Questions into Self-Contained Sub-Questions with Reusable Answers
items.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) lets a large language model (LLM) answer questions by retrieving relevant passages from a large corpus. However, RAG struggles with multi-hop questions, which require chaining facts spread across several documents through intermediate entities that the question never mentions. Graph-based RAG methods retrieve once from the entities a question names and so rarely recover the full evidence chain. Iterative RAG methods recover it step by step, but their accuracy
items.title_cn: DeFT-RAG：将多跳问题分解为带可复用答案的自包含子问题
items.note: 针对多跳问答检索不全的问题，把复杂问题拆成可复用答案的子问题来补齐证据链。

items.title_en: From Fragmentation to Fusion: A Survey and Roadmap for Omnimodal Embeddings
items.summary: Embedding models underpin virtually every modern AI system, from search engines to recommendation systems. Despite shared mathematical foundations, research on embedding models remains fragmented by modality: the communities develop largely in isolation, seldom exchanging insights. We argue that this fragmentation obscures a deeper convergence. Driven by contrastive learning, Transformer architectures, and a granularity shift, embedding research across modalities is converging toward a common se
items.title_cn: 从碎片到融合：全模态嵌入的综述与路线图
items.note: 综述各模态嵌入研究各自为战，主张它们正因对比学习和Transformer走向统一。

items.title_en: MAServeBench: Benchmarking Multi-Agent LLM Serving Systems with Hierarchical Collaboration Workloads
items.summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) coordinate specialized agents to solve complex tasks, turning each user request into interdependent model and tool operations. Unlike independent requests, these operations become ready at different times and consume evolving context as agents coordinate and exchange results. This creates changing patterns of concurrency, computation, and memory demand that can expose different bottlenecks in LLM serving hardware. Yet benchmarking these
items.title_cn: MAServeBench：用分层协作负载评测多智能体大模型服务系统
items.note: 构建基准评测多智能体协作时并发与内存需求变化给大模型服务硬件带来的瓶颈。

items.title_en: FrameForge: Harnessing Priors of Video Foundation Models for Unified Image Generation
items.summary: Unified conditional image generation requires a single model to preserve different aspects of a visual input while producing a target image that follows textual guidance. Pretrained video models provide a promising foundation by encoding visual transformations across time, yet existing approaches typically assign the condition and target to fixed temporal positions. We observe that condition-target relationships vary substantially across generation tasks, while video models naturally encode visu
items.title_cn: FrameForge：利用视频基础模型先验的统一图像生成
items.note: 借用视频模型对视觉变化的编码能力，让单一模型完成多种条件图像生成任务。

items.title_en: R^2Orch: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Orchestration via Self-Play within a Skill-Internalization Loop
items.summary: In recent years, agentic orchestration has been widely applied to solve complex human tasks. However, existing orchestration learning still faces key challenges, including hand-designed curricula, advantage collapse when a task's rollouts all reach the same outcome, and unreliable evaluation signals that judge each skill by one noisy score. To address these challenges, we propose R^2Orch, a new paradigm of Recursive Self-Play Orchestration: an inner loop of self-play that improves the orchestrat
items.title_cn: R^2Orch：通过技能内化循环中的自博弈实现智能体编排的递归自我改进
items.note: 用自博弈内循环改进编排器，缓解人工课程、优势崩塌和评价信号不可靠问题。

items.title_en: REA: A Routed Embodied Agent Runtime for Asynchronous Brain-Cerebellum Control
items.summary: Foundation models are becoming remarkably reliable at high-level reasoning, yet they remain too slow and costly to serve as fine-grained controllers. Conversely, fast policies like VLAs and whole-body controllers offer more efficient reflexes, but struggle to generalize. While pairing a deliberative brain (foundation models) with a reactive cerebellum (fast policies) seems natural for embodied systems, two obstacles remain: methods are built and scored on incompatible stacks, and their asynchron
items.title_cn: REA：面向异步脑-小脑控制的具身智能体路由运行时
items.note: 把慢速基础模型当大脑、快速策略当小脑，用路由运行时解决两者异步配合问题。

items.title_en: Does Scaling Toward AGI Depend on What System-1 Lets System-2 Execute?
items.summary: Progress toward artificial general intelligence (AGI) has largely relied on scaling a resource-intensive executive, System-2, through larger models, more data and compute, longer reasoning, and more agents. We ask whether the next stage may come instead from co-designing it with System-1, a lightweight, semantically aware predictor that evaluates candidate interactions before execution, so that System-2 acts only on those worth their cost. Our answer is a qualified yes. We study conditional inte
items.title_cn: 迈向AGI的扩展是否取决于System-1让System-2执行什么？
items.note: 提出用轻量System-1先筛选值得执行的交互，让昂贵的System-2只处理有价值的部分。

items.title_en: Apriel Voice 27B Preview: An Open Model for Speech, Reasoning, and Tool Use
items.summary: A capable voice assistant must do more than recognize words; it must understand requests, reason over context, sustain conversations, and act through tools. We present Apriel Voice 27B Preview, an open speech-language model that unifies these capabilities within a shared reasoning backbone while retaining text and image input modalities. Built on the post-trained Gemma 4 26B-A4B checkpoint, Apriel Voice directly processes speech and generates both responses and tool calls without requiring a sep
items.title_cn: Apriel Voice 27B预览版：面向语音、推理与工具使用的开放模型
items.note: 基于Gemma检查点构建开放语音语言模型，直接处理语音并输出回答与工具调用。

items.title_en: Look Only When Needed: Certificate-Guided Visual Routing for Efficient Diffusion VLMs
items.summary: Diffusion vision-language models (DVLMs) process their entire input at every denoising step. Since visual tokens make up 89-97% of this input on the benchmarks we study, most of the decoding computation is spent repeatedly processing the same image. Visual token pruning methods partially relieve this burden by removing part of the visual tokens, but they lose the removed information and still process the remaining image at every step. To measure how often the image is actually needed, we compare
items.title_cn: 按需才看：面向高效扩散视觉语言模型的凭证引导视觉路由
items.note: 发现扩散视觉语言模型每步重复处理图像，提出按需路由视觉令牌以减少计算。

items.title_en: Your Benchmark Is an Empirical Measure Over Difficulty
items.summary: A benchmark is not merely a collection of test questions; it naturally induces an empirical measure over difficulty. In this work, we develop this measure-based view of benchmark evaluation. This perspective allows us to identify and formalize two central failure modes: measure mismatch, where the benchmark difficulty distribution differs from the intended difficulty distribution, and coverage gaps, where uncovered regions along the difficulty axis prevent benchmarks from detecting meaningful lo
items.title_cn: 你的基准是一个关于难度的经验测度
items.note: 把基准视为难度上的经验分布，形式化测度错配与覆盖缺口两种评测失效模式。

items.title_en: A-RSI: Adaptive Task Refresh for Zero-Data Multimodal Self-Improvement
items.summary: Recursive self-improvement requires models not only to acquire useful training experience, but also to decide when their current experience has ceased to be useful. Existing methods often focus on what experience to generate next, while paying less attention to when fresh experience should be introduced. Many also construct training targets through self-consistency or majority voting, making supervision depend on the model's own uncertain predictions. We address these two questions separately: t
items.title_cn: A-RSI：面向零数据多模态自我改进的自适应任务刷新
items.note: 研究何时引入新训练经验，并减少对模型自身不确定预测的监督依赖。

items.title_en: Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs
items.summary: Whether models trained on different modalities converge to the same representation of the world is central to AI. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) conjectures that they do as they scale, but without a proof it offers neither a guarantee nor a recipe. We turn the hypothesis into a theorem. First, we prove a Platonic Representation Theorem: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) trained separately on any number of modalities learn the same representation up to one rotation wh
items.title_cn: 用JEPA证明并改进柏拉图表示假说
items.note: 证明多模态分别训练的JEPA学到仅差一个旋转的相同表示，把假说变成定理。

items.title_en: WorkFactory: Turning Professional Intents into Executable Work for Scalable Agent Training
items.summary: Scaling supervised training for working agents requires diverse professional tasks that yield reliable expert demonstrations. However, missing or inconsistent task information can obstruct teacher execution and weaken the resulting supervision. We propose WorkFactory, a scalable framework for constructing coherent and executable professional tasks. Starting from professional intents, information-level planning builds an information support graph to guide task instantiation, explicitly representi
items.title_cn: WorkFactory：把专业意图转化为可执行工作以扩展智能体训练
items.note: 从专业意图构建信息支撑图，生成连贯可执行的专业任务用于智能体监督训练。

items.title_en: OmniShowcase: Omnidirectional Subject-Consistent Video Generation from Multi-View Images
items.summary: Generating videos of a specific subject from a few reference images remains challenging when the camera reveals surfaces that are not visible in the input. Early subject-to-video (S2V) methods condition on a single reference image and must therefore infer the subject's unseen appearance and geometry as the viewpoint changes. To address this limitation, recent methods extend S2V to multiple reference views, providing more information about the subject from different viewpoints. However, they do n
items.title_cn: OmniShowcase：从多视角图像生成全向主体一致视频
items.note: 利用多视角参考图补足单图看不到的表面，生成视角变化下主体一致的视频。

items.title_en: Efficient Streaming Audio-Visual Target Speaker Extraction for Real-World Acoustic Scenes
items.summary: Streaming audio-visual target speaker extraction (AVTSE) is essential for latency-sensitive applications. However, current causal systems face two coupled gaps. First, standard benchmarks fix the number of speakers at two and ignore the near-/far-field interference, reverberation, and sudden noise of real scenes. Second, high-performance causal architectures are too heavy for edge deployment. Lightweight alternatives try to reclaim capacity by repeatedly invoking a small separator, which offsets
items.title_cn: 面向真实声学场景的高效流式音视频目标说话人提取
items.note: 针对真实场景多说话人与混响，提出轻量因果架构实现低延迟流式说话人提取。

items.title_en: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving
items.summary: Agentic services alternate between model inference on clustered GPUs and external tools on distributed CPUs. In this scenario, existing systems (1) overlook tool-return readiness in service evaluation, wasting limited resources, and (2) use heuristic strategies to decide admission and placement on GPUs, resulting in suboptimal scheduling decisions. To bridge this gap, we present TAO, a tool-aware joint scheduling framework for LLM-based agentic serving. Its value interface combines near-term too
items.title_cn: TAO：面向大模型智能体服务的工具感知联合调度
items.note: 联合调度GPU模型推理与CPU外部工具，考虑工具返回就绪以优化智能体服务。

items.title_en: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
items.summary: Robot foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, motivating low-cost offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. We ask whether motion trajectories form another such modality: as embodied models become more capable, should their sensory representations converge toward the structure of phy
items.title_cn: 感觉运动对齐：具身策略成功率的柏拉图式代理指标
items.note: 探究运动轨迹是否也像视觉语言一样收敛到共享现实结构，用作低成本离线评估代理。

items.title_en: HuGe: Scaling Humanoid Generalist Vision-Language-Action Models with Egocentric Experience
items.summary: Extending Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) to humanoid robots requires coordinated whole-body control and diverse demonstrations that are costly to collect in real-world scenarios. Although egocentric human demonstrations provide a complementary source of task experience, differences in visual embodiment and missing robot proprioception complicate transfer to humanoid policies. To address these challenges, we introduce HuGe, a family of Humanoid Generalist VLAs pre-trained on over 2,000 hour
items.title_cn: HuGe：用第一人称经验扩展人形通用视觉-语言-动作模型
items.note: 用超2000小时第一人称人类演示预训练人形机器人全身控制策略，缓解数据难采集。

items.title_en: PDRVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Physical Dynamics Representations
items.summary: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions, but their understanding of physical dynamics remains limited. Video world models can capture scene dynamics, yet generating future videos introduces high latency into the control loop. We introduce PDRVLA, whose lightweight Physical Dynamics Module extracts physical tokens from vision--language features to condition action generation without online video generation. The module learns
items.title_cn: PDRVLA：带物理动态表示的视觉-语言-动作模型
items.note: 用轻量物理动态模块从视觉语言特征提取物理令牌，避免在线生成视频的高延迟。

items.title_en: Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation
items.summary: Interactive world generation requires models to follow successive commands while preserving relevant history and action consequences. We present Hy-Nomas, a video world model with an 8B diffusion backbone that supports free-form text instructions and continuous camera control across multiple interaction turns. It generates variable-length segments conditioned on current inputs and cached history. Our central design aligns structured video captions with action-aware causal attention: descriptive
items.title_cn: Hy-Nomas：迈向自由形式交互式世界生成
items.note: 8B扩散视频世界模型，支持多轮自由文本指令与连续相机控制并保留历史。

items.title_en: Rollback: Experience Backtracking in World Models for Policy Improvement
items.summary: Action-conditioned world models offer a scalable alternative to costly real-world interaction for improving robot policies. However, existing world-model-based methods largely treat world models as forward-only surrogates of the physical environment, leaving untapped a capability no physical environment affords: rewinding to past decision points to explore counterfactual futures. We introduce Rollback, a policy improvement paradigm that turns world models from passive simulators into counterfact
items.title_cn: Rollback：世界模型中的经验回溯用于策略改进
items.note: 让世界模型能回退到过去决策点探索反事实未来，把被动模拟器变成策略改进工具。

items.title_en: ChronoReplay: One Answer Interface Is Not Enough for Streaming Spatial Intelligence
items.summary: Training a spatial VLM to answer which side an object lies on does not require it to preserve the metric displacement that determines that answer, while supervision for a distance estimate may leave categorical relations largely unconstrained. When post-training emphasizes one readout, improvements can therefore concentrate on that interface while transfer to others remains weak or even degrades; we call this observed specialization interface lock-in. ChronoReplay addresses it by replaying heter
items.title_cn: ChronoReplay：单一答案接口不足以支撑流式空间智能
items.note: 指出后训练易造成接口锁定，用重放异构监督缓解空间推理能力偏科。

items.title_en: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
items.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Human videos provide much broader behavioral and environmental experience, while learning from them faces a fundamental trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. We introduce ThinkWorld, a VLA learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics and strength
items.title_cn: ThinkWorld：世界想象强化动态链推理
items.note: 利用人类视频，把动作推理建立在世界动态上，缓解机器人演示数据覆盖不足。

items.title_en: Work Agents: Systems, Capabilities, and Optimization
items.summary: As foundation models evolve from information generation to digital work execution, agents are increasingly capable of completing complex tasks across tools, applications, and workflows. However, existing research lacks a unified perspective on how agents reliably accomplish delegated work. To address this gap, we present a work-centric, system-level perspective that views work agents as systems combining foundation models and runtime harnesses to execute tasks in stateful workspaces and deliver
items.title_cn: 工作智能体：系统、能力与优化
items.note: 从系统层面综述工作智能体如何结合基础模型与运行时在状态化工作区完成任务。

items.title_en: StreamVibe: Proactive Video Agents for Evolving User Intent
items.summary: Vision-language models are shifting from offline passive understanding toward online proactive interaction. However, prevailing methods largely rely on explicit requests while miss the implicit user intent (e.g., "where should I click next?" while a user navigate a website), meanwhile fail to update the state simultaneously as user requests might update continuously. These limitations make them less suited to intent-aware interaction in practical. To address these challenges, we introduce Stream
items.title_cn: StreamVibe：面向演化用户意图的主动视频智能体
items.note: 针对隐式且持续变化的用户意图，提出能主动交互并同步更新状态的视频智能体。

items.title_en: Trajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents
items.summary: Successful tool-use trajectories are not necessarily useful supervision. Even successful interactions may underrepresent multi-step dependencies or contain actions that are unjustified by the information visible to the agent at decision time. We identify two coupled requirements for effective trajectory supervision: compositional coverage, so that important observation-action dependencies are represented, and decision grounding, so that each supervised action is supported by the learner-visible
items.title_cn: Trajectory2Gym：面向工具使用智能体的决策接地组合交互合成
items.note: 指出成功轨迹未必是好监督，要求组合覆盖与决策接地以生成有效训练数据。

items.title_en: InteractiveWorld: A Verifiable Human-Centric Environment for Building Better Interactive MLLM Assistants
items.summary: People have long dreamed of an assistant that is always there to guide them and remind what they forget, from new dishes to lost keys. Powered by multimodal large language models (MLLMs), egocentric AI assistants on wearable devices are bringing this dream within reach: they see what the user sees and give instructions for user's physical work when necessary. However, testing such assistance is challenging and usually requires real people. The expensive and rare real interaction data leaves a ke
items.title_cn: InteractiveWorld：构建更好交互式多模态助手的人类中心可验证环境
items.note: 搭建可验证的第一人称交互环境，缓解训练评测多模态助手缺乏真实交互数据的问题。

items.title_en: Trial by Trace: Benchmarking AI Agent Harnesses for Reliability and Failure Attribution
items.summary: LLM agents are increasingly used to solve real-world problems, and their effectiveness depends on both the underlying models and the harnesses that support their operation. However, most existing benchmarks focus on model capabilities and overall agent performance, with limited attention to the evaluation of agent harnesses. To address this gap, we introduce TraceTrial-Bench, which organizes harness reliability into seven components covering context, execution, governance, lifecycle, observabili
items.title_cn: TraceTrial：评测AI智能体运行框架的可靠性与失败归因
items.note: 构建基准从七个组件维度评测智能体运行框架的可靠性并做失败归因。

items.title_en: UserArena: Benchmarking Interactive User Simulation for Long-Horizon Shopping Agents
items.summary: Agentic recommendation pursues shopper goals through sequences of context-dependent decisions. Developing and evaluating such policies requires faithful recommendation world models that capture both the interactive shopping environment and users' behavioral responses over long interactions. Existing resources rarely provide long-horizon, fine-grained real-user trajectories or support trajectory-level evaluation and offline validation against production A/B results. We introduce UserArena, a real
items.title_cn: UserArena：面向长程购物智能体的交互式用户模拟评测
items.note: 提供真实长程购物用户轨迹与模拟环境，支持轨迹级评测和离线验证。

items.title_en: HiSTEVE 1.0: Harnessing Human-Interface VLA Agents for Open-World Games
items.summary: Building virtual embodied agents that operate in open-ended games like human players is a long-standing goal requiring both long-horizon autonomy and reliable native-interface control. As a procedurally generated open world, Minecraft provides a natural testbed for studying the integration of these capabilities. Existing agents typically provide either native visuomotor control without long-horizon autonomy or high-level planning executed through environment APIs or predefined skills. To bridge
items.title_cn: HiSTEVE 1.0：利用人机界面VLA智能体玩开放世界游戏
items.note: 在Minecraft中用原生界面控制的VLA智能体，兼顾长程自主与可靠操作。

items.title_en: RynnUnify: Towards Unified Embodied Brain
items.summary: We introduce RynnUnify, a 16B unified embodied model that combines strong embodied understanding with long-horizon visual planning through interleaved video--language reasoning. With capabilities spanning spatial reasoning, physical prediction, and grounding, RynnUnify connects an understanding of the physical world with visual anticipation of how it evolves across successive subtasks. Building on these capabilities, we further develop an agentic extension through reinforcement learning to selec
items.title_cn: RynnUnify：迈向统一具身大脑
items.note: 16B统一具身模型，通过交错视频语言推理结合空间理解、物理预测与长程视觉规划。

items.title_en: RSIHub: A Composable Framework for Agent-Evolution Methods
items.summary: Agent-evolution methods use execution feedback to improve prompts, skills, tools, and orchestration, but their implementations often rebuild the same experimental machinery. We present RSIHub, an open-source framework for building, comparing, and extending these methods on shared infrastructure. Recipes compose reusable operators and declare mutable resources; RSIHub supplies execution, evaluation, recovery, and lineage. Researchers can focus on evolution policy while evaluation stays outside th
items.title_cn: RSIHub：智能体演化方法的可组合框架
items.note: 开源框架用可复用算子组合智能体演化方法，共享执行、评测、恢复与血缘管理。

items.title_en: On-Policy Self-Training: Data-Free Self-Improvement in Large Language Models
items.summary: On-policy self-distillation enables post-training foundation models without relying on stronger external teachers. However, existing approaches rely on ground-truth question-answer pairs, human-curated problem sets, or other supervised signals. In this work, we reformulate on-policy self-distillation as a self-training framework, driven by self-generated question-answer pairs and privileged reasoning demonstrations. We push supervision to the limit: guided solely by coarse, high-level topic desc
items.title_cn: 同策略自训练：大语言模型的无数据自我改进
items.note: 仅凭高层主题描述，用自生成问答对和特权推理示范实现无需外部数据的自我训练。

huggingface.models_summary: 这批模型整体看：一是多模态成主流，图像文本输入、语音识别都出现；二是参数规模跨度大，从17亿到超大模型都有；三是厂商覆盖LiquidAI、DeepSeek、英伟达、Mistral、百度。对跟进AI圈和备考的人，值得注意模型类型标签比名字更可靠，很多项目资料很少，要学会看任务类型和项目页，别只凭名称判断能力。
huggingface.papers_summary: 这批论文集中在智能体系统与评测、具身机器人与视觉-语言-动作模型、世界模型与视频生成、多模态嵌入与表示理论，以及大模型自我改进与高效服务调度。新手可记住关键词：智能体编排、VLA、世界模型、多模态嵌入、自蒸馏、基准评测。
